notes: Fixed: Android male voice speaks at its natural speed instead of sounding slow or muffled, and every installed voice can now be chosen in Settings.
Improved: reminders now ask for notification permission when you add one, and the app can hand upcoming reminders to the background service worker.
Faster: removed the heavy glass blur, so scrolling and tapping respond quicker on phones.
New: Voice diagnostics shows the exact voices your phone reports if the sound is still not right.
New: Force reload latest version clears stale app files when an update does not appear.
Cleaner: the home screen is more compact and the update card is simpler.
